title: LLM training work must declare the task objective, output

metadata.classification_notes: Phase 36 AI Engineering reviewed knowledge; UI tree and canonical node are inherited from candidate classification. Trading rule bodies must remain in Trading Engineering.

applies_when: Building or auditing LLM training, RAG, MCP, evaluation, or governance for trade quality scoring/gating assistants.
not_applicable_when: The task asks for concrete trading entries, exits, position sizing, account-specific settings, or live order execution.

content.statement: LLM training work must declare the task objective, output schema, evaluation target, and authority boundary before data collection or fine-tuning starts.
content.rationale: This candidate is scoped to AI Engineering governance for LLM trade quality scoring/gating systems. It does not define trading signals, order execution rules, or strategy parameters. 审计结论：方向成立。训练工作开始前必须声明 task objective、output schema、evaluation target 和 authority boundary，这是模型优化、SFT/DPO 方法选择、数据收集和上线治理的前置条件。OpenAI model optimization 支持先定义目标和 eval baseline，TRL 支持区分 SFT/DPO/reward modeling 等训练方法。可进入 draft。
